# Form Items: Upsert a Form Item

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`PUT /users/{userId}/form-items/{formItemId}` · tenant-scoped token

Insert or Update a form item with the provided external id. If it does not exist, one is created.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `userId` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |
| `formItemId` | A unique external id for a form item. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form_item` | one of several shapes | Yes |  |

Example request body:

```json
{"form_item":{"document_type":"5498","ira_contributions":"100.00","rollover_contributions":"100.00","roth_ira_conversion_amount":"100.00","recharacterized_contributions":"100.00","life_insurance_cost":"100.00","sep_contributions":"100.00","simple_contributions":"100.00","roth_ira_contributions":"100.00","postponed_late_contribution":"100.00","year_13b":"100.00","code_13c":"EO13239","repayments":"100.00","code_14b":"QR","fmv_of_certain_specified_assets":"100.00","code_15b":"B"}}
```

**Response 200**: Successful upsert response with external form id

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | External id of the form item. |

**Response 201**: Form item created

Same fields as the response of [Upsert a Form Item](upsert-a-form-item.md).

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
